## 更新亮点

- **EPUB 排版升级**：改进 CSS 样式、表格、首字下沉、注音和两端对齐，支持按字号百分比设置行距。
- **词典功能增强**：支持在释义中继续查词、格式化释义、同义词，以及同一词条的多条完整解释。
- **图片阅读改进**：新增 EPUB 图片灰度开关，支持 GIF 静态图片；动画 GIF 显示首帧，暂不支持交错 GIF。
- **书源与同步扩展**：支持 OPDS 2.0，并可为 OPDS 和 KOReader 同步配置自定义 HTTP 请求头。
- **插件管理完善**：新增插件总开关、可选插件中心安装入口和独立网页管理页，改进插件目录与阅读事件处理。
- **蓝牙翻页器改进**：统一配对与按键管理，新增阅读菜单快捷开关；未选择翻页器时，阅读期间保持蓝牙关闭。
- **设置与界面调整**：设置按六类重新组织，统一 INX 首页与子页状态栏，改善横屏文字设置与菜单操作。
- **稳定性修复**：改进字体加载、大字体列表和网页文件传输，修复 OPDS 详情页崩溃、热点门户及 SD 写入相关问题。

## 升级说明

- 旧排版缓存会自动重建，保留书籍元数据和阅读进度。
- 插件全新安装默认关闭，已有插件的升级用户自动保留启用状态。
- 正式版提供 Xteink X3/X4 共用固件，以及 Seeed Sticky、Xteink X4 Pro 和 Metalio E-Ink 4 各自的固件包。请选择与设备对应的固件。

## Highlights

- **EPUB layout improvements**: Better CSS styles, tables, drop caps, ruby annotations and justified text, with line spacing configurable as a percentage of font size.
- **Enhanced dictionaries**: Look up words within definitions, display formatted entries, resolve synonyms and show all definitions for the same headword.
- **Image reading improvements**: Add an EPUB image grayscale toggle and static GIF support. Animated GIFs display their first frame; interlaced GIFs are not supported.
- **Catalog and sync extensions**: Support OPDS 2.0 and custom HTTP headers for OPDS and KOReader Sync.
- **Plugin management improvements**: Add a global plugin toggle, an optional Plugin Hub installer and a dedicated web management page, with improved catalogs and reading-event handling.
- **Bluetooth page-turner improvements**: Unify pairing and button management, add a reader-menu quick toggle and keep Bluetooth off while reading when no remote is selected.
- **Settings and interface updates**: Organize settings into six groups, align INX home and subpage status bars, and improve landscape text settings and menu controls.
- **Reliability fixes**: Improve font loading, large font lists and web file transfers; fix OPDS details crashes, hotspot portal behavior and SD write issues.

## Upgrade notes

- Existing layout caches rebuild automatically. Book metadata and reading progress are preserved.
- Plugins start disabled on clean installs. Upgrades with existing plugins keep them enabled automatically.
- Stable provides one shared Xteink X3/X4 image and separate firmware packages for Seeed Sticky, Xteink X4 Pro and Metalio E-Ink 4. Select the package matching your device.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0x1abin/crossmux/compare/1.6.5...2.0.0
